purpose: Fresh targeted replication of the conditional-covariance mechanism in a stratum identified from the earlier random-product-box study.
selection_history: The coherent, 16-mode, balanced-volume stratum and dimensions 10 and 20 were selected after inspection of the earlier holdout. The seeds below have not been instantiated. This study is a targeted replication and does not estimate prevalence over arbitrary feasible sets.

seeds.derivation: First eight hexadecimal digits of SHA-256 strings cov-geometry-holdout-2026-09-12, cov-direction-holdout-2026-09-12, and cov-bootstrap-holdout-2026-09-12, interpreted as unsigned integers.

primary_analysis.spectral_endpoint: maximum finite KL to Gaussian KL ratio over the four fixed sigma and normalized-distance combinations in the top-covariance direction
primary_analysis.independent_endpoint: maximum finite KL to Gaussian KL ratio over the same four combinations in the independently seeded direction
primary_analysis.paired_exceedance_test: one-sided exact sign test among discordant geometry-level indicators with null probability one half
primary_analysis.repeated_cell_statistics: descriptive only unless reported within a fixed dimension, sigma, distance, and direction stratum

precommitted_checks.failure_policy: If the numerical identity check fails, retain the run and debug without replacing seeds. If the identity passes but a substantive check fails, retain all results and do not tune another holdout. Main-text inclusion depends on the frozen checks rather than favorable visual selection.

figure_specification.panel_a: Anchor directional covariance ratio against finite KL ratio for every retained factor row, with direction rules separated and equality and unit lines shown.
figure_specification.panel_b: Maximum independent-direction ratio against maximum top-covariance ratio for every base geometry, with dimensions separated and equality and unit lines shown.
figure_specification.path_identity_role: Numerical implementation check, not empirical discovery.
